method: Actual Edge canvas and semantic controls. Read-only geometry/raycast observer; camera moved only by native menu/keys. One explicit optional-projection failure tests fallback; a temporary opaque plane tests blocked pressed-surface release. Neither injection is used for positive cases and authorization is never replaced.
